headline: Premier Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process - Premier Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of the Twenty-First Meeting of Committee of Creditors of Premier Limited, the Corporate Debtor was scheduled to be held on Thursday,…
detail: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process - Premier Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of the Twenty-First Meeting of Committee of Creditors of Premier Limited, the Corporate Debtor was scheduled to be held on Thursday, December 11th, 2025 at 11:00 A.M., the same was rescheduled and duly held on Friday, December 12th, 2025 at 12:00 P.M.
